scope: Original two equal Okayu portions with the listed toppings. Uses ingredient reference values for dry porridge rice, plain salted umeboshi, raw spring onion and unhulled sesame. The rinse loss for rice is not measured. The only calculated public nutrient in this scope is available carbohydrate.
withholdingReason: Whole-portion available carbohydrate uses native composition fields. Separate total carbohydrate and other macros remain withheld because polyols in the rice and complete macro/fibre values in the umeboshi are not verified.
